name: CustomerLead — Dashboard sync and manual Gmail sending

parameters.content:
# Dashboard bridge: sync + manual sending
Use this workflow instead of the old sync bridge AND the standalone sender. Keep the original AI-support automation as workflow 1. This is workflow 2.

Set Bridge settings, select Sheets credentials on 3 nodes, CRM Header Auth on 5 nodes, and the SAME Gmail OAuth2 account on 6 Gmail requests. The lower path sends ONLY owner-approved, explicitly confirmed replies. Never retry its send node.

Run a full Manual connection test with an empty mail queue first. See customerlead-setup-and-testing.pdf for the setup and test sequence.

nodes.name: Read owner changes
nodes.notes: Select the CustomerLead HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <private token>. No token is included in this file.

parameters.jsCode: const c = $('Loop changes').item.json; return {json:{changeId:c.id,status:$json.error ? 'Failed' : 'Applied',detail:$json.error ? 'Sheets update failed. Check the credential, headers, and spreadsheet.' : 'Shared lead row updated in Sheets.',executionId:$execution.id}};
const c = $('Loop changes').item.json; return {json:{changeId:c.id,status:'Failed',detail:$json._syncError || 'Update needs review.',executionId:$execution.id}};

nodes.name: Read Gmail draft
nodes.notes: Select your Gmail OAuth2 credential. Reads the existing draft to protect attachments, copied recipients, and thread identity.

nodes.name: Update Gmail draft — never send
nodes.notes: Updates an existing draft only. There is no send operation.
